_comment: Site-wide pop-up. mode 'acknowledge' shows it each visit until the visitor clicks 'Don't show this again'; closing with X or Esc dismisses for that session only. Change 'id' for a NEW message. Other modes: 'once', 'untilDate' (with endDate), 'always'.
